verdict.rationale: Workers documents 'built-in observability' for deep visibility, which plausibly covers tracking application performance, but it is a single marketing-level mention. Nothing in the evidence shows visitor-behavior analytics such as page views, visitors, or traffic sources. Missing for 10: any documented visitor or traffic analytics, specifics of the performance metrics, dashboards or retention details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics

citations.quote: Gain deep visibility and insight with built-in observability
